title: AFCI-Bench v2 Architecture-Conformance Oracle Result
description: Direct architectural-conformance measurement for one run: per-rule outcomes plus the violation count/rate and applicable-rule satisfaction proportion (CON-AC). Assembled from the raw, blind architecture_finding.json; the optional raw_violation_count and *_opportunity_count fields record raw violations and frozen-opportunity accounting SEPARATELY (the applicable-opportunity denominator is frozen per task manifest, not derived from touched files), and applicable-rule satisfaction is a descriptive transformation (D8), not an independent endpoint. condition/model are appended only after blind scoring. Development scaffolding for study v2; no paid run produced it. Conformance is NOT churn/Delta-CodeLOC and NOT visible-CI pass.

verdict.description: CONFORMANT/VIOLATIONS/PENDING are assembled from a scored architecture_finding.json. FAIL_CLOSED carries the raw finding's fail-closed verdict faithfully (kept distinct from PENDING, which means awaiting manual rating); a run that fails closed by the engine throwing instead records an INFRA_* exit_reason on the run manifest and produces no scored result.

raw_violation_count.description: Optional. Count of all violations detected in the whole snapshot (recorded separately from frozen-opportunity accounting).

applicable_opportunity_count.description: Optional. Frozen applicable-opportunity denominator from the evaluator manifest; NOT derived from files/layers touched.

finding_artifact_ref.description: Optional. Path to the raw architecture_finding.json this result was assembled from.

blind_scored.description: Optional. True when the finding was produced without condition/model in scope (condition/model appended afterward).
